newsitem.title: USA: United Auto sets Houston-area acquistions.
newsitem.headline: United Auto sets Houston-area acquistions.

text.p: United Auto Group Inc said Wednesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire 100 percent of the partnership interests in Shannon Automotive Ltd, which operates Crown Dodge and Crown Jeep Eagle Chrysler-Plymouth in Houston, Texas.
The consideration for the acquisition is about $14 million, including cash, United Auto common valued at about $7 million and the assumption of debt, the company said.

United Auto said it has guaranteed that, when the common stock issued in the transaction becomes freely tradable, it will be worth at least $23.50 per share, the value assigned to the stock in pricing the transaction.
It said the transaction is expected to close by February 1997 and is subject to Chrysler Corp approval, as well as other customary conditions.
